title: Super simple and functional
body:
For creative minds that just need simple reminder / to do list because for the rest they have their brains. Light, fast and perfectly integrated in gmail. Well designed column bar on gmail and app for phone.

You can write your ideas, thoughts, tasks on the go because it's fast and light and does not ask you milion details.

Later you can add date, description, subtasks which is great to have as option but I mostly use it as "to do" list which helps me keep track of daily routine but does not try to think instead of me.

It's non agressive, distraction free tool that works perfectly and complimentary with gmail.
